request.deadline: Contract year through 2026-2027; architecture assessment by Q3 2027; IOG contract stated as closing August 31, 2026
deliverables: Protocol maintenance including node upgrades, wallet backend updates, hard fork readiness, platform support, dependency maintenance, Nix build infrastructure, and release engineering
Compatible Daedalus stable release at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork
Leios, Peras, and Nested Transactions readiness as those protocols progress toward testnet or mainnet
Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support, plus additional newer hardware wallet models as they emerge during the contract period
CIP-30 dApp connector implementation within Daedalus with documentation and interoperability verification
Ongoing user support through GitHub, community forums, and direct channels, including Japanese-language support
Full Japanese translation maintained across all new features
Architecture assessment covering current state, options, resource estimates, and recommendation
Independent financial audit and test hardware acquisition, with unspent labor, hardware, and audit budget returned to the treasury
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc. via Intersect administration and milestone-based disbursement
request.what: Daedalus Wallet Maintenance and Improvements 2026-2027 delivered by Se7en Labs, Inc.

claims.claim: Daedalus is described as Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet, running an embedded Cardano node and deriving wallet and governance data directly from chain data without third-party APIs or trusted backends.

The proposal states Daedalus has approximately 4,000 monthly active users according to opt-in telemetry, while asserting the true count is meaningfully higher because privacy-conscious users are less likely to opt in.

Se7en Labs says it assumed Daedalus responsibility under an IOG contract in January 2026 and shipped Mithril Snapshot Bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend integration, Apple Silicon builds, a release CLI, Nix build modernization, and Daedalus 8.0 and 11.0 during that contract period.

The proposal commits to a compatible stable Daedalus release at least 2 weeks before every mainnet hard fork and says release timing and version-currency metrics are independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain.
The scope includes maintaining Electron, Node.js, wallet dependencies, reproducible Nix builds, signing continuity, and all platform targets across Windows, macOS x86_64, macOS aarch64, and Linux.
The proposal requests 1,785,333 ADA, consisting of 1,666,667 ADA for team labor, 33,333 ADA for test hardware, 33,333 ADA for financial audit, and 52,000 ADA for Intersect budget administration.
The proposer states that any unspent labor, hardware, and audit budget at contract close will be returned to the treasury.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.

The proposal states Intersect will administer funds, independently verify milestones, authorize monthly disbursements against verified work, and hold treasury funds in a dedicated account auditable by the Cardano Community.

The proposer states Se7en Labs has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months and that its Daedalus work has instead been under a direct IOG contract closing August 31, 2026.

summary: The proposal requests 1,785,333 ADA for a time-and-materials public-good maintenance and improvement engagement for Daedalus, with protocol compatibility, release engineering, hardware wallet support, CIP-30, Japanese localisation, user support, audit, and Intersect-administered oversight as its main commitments.
